= Preprocessor Showcase
:lang: en
:edition: 2

ifdef::lang[]
Hello, this content is gated by a defined attribute.
endif::[]

ifndef::missing[]
This is shown because `missing` is not set.
endif::[]

ifeval::[{edition} >= 2]
We are on edition 2 or later.
endif::[]

ifeval::["{lang}" == "en"]
Localised paragraph for English.
endif::[]

include::22_preprocessor_part.adoc[]

The end.
